Home inspections in Tucson

Know the house before you sign.

Eric Almquist is an Arizona certified home inspector, certified since 2003. He inspects homes in Tucson for buyers and sellers.

Book an inspectionCall (520) 749-6689

Who Eric works for

When you book an inspection, Eric Almquist works for you. The report he writes is for you too, so you can make up your own mind about the house before the deal is done.

Four inspections

What Eric inspects

  1. I

    For buyers

    Home inspection

    Eric goes through the house you're under contract on, from the roof and attic down to the plumbing and the electrical panel. You get a written report of what he found.

  2. II

    For sellers

    Pre-listing inspection

    See what a buyer's inspector is likely to find before the house goes on the market. Then you can fix it first or price it in.

  3. III

    For new builds

    New construction inspection

    Builders miss things too. Get the new house looked over before you take the keys.

  4. IV

    For a pool or spa

    Pool and spa inspection

    A look at the pool or spa and the equipment that runs it, so you know what comes with the house.

Check it yourself

Can I check that Eric is certified?

Yes. Arizona certifies home inspectors through the State Board of Technical Registration, and anyone can search its register. On the board's website, open the licensee search and type Almquist or 39416.

How booking works

What buyers and sellers ask

How much does an inspection cost?

It depends on the house and on which inspections you need. Give him the address and you'll have a price before you book.

When should I book it?

If you're buying, call as soon as your offer is accepted. Your purchase contract gives you a set window for inspections, and you want the report in hand with time left to ask the seller for repairs.

If you're selling, call before the listing goes live.

Does Eric inspect outside Tucson?

He's based in Tucson. Call with the address and he'll tell you whether he can get to it.

What do I get at the end?

A written report of what Eric found. You can share it with your agent and use it when you talk repairs with the seller.

If your question isn't here, call (520) 749-6689.
